basics.name: Aryaman Rao
basics.label: Graduate Student | Robotics Engineer
basics.summary: Robotics engineer focused on autonomous driving, motion planning, and efficiency-aware machine learning systems. Experienced across the full autonomy stack, from perception and sensor fusion to planning, control, and large-scale simulation.

work.name: MCity: University of Michigan Transportation Research Institute
work.summary: Worked on localization, trajectory planning, and simulation for semi co-driving autonomous systems.
highlights: Developed ROS2 C++ localization and lateral/longitudinal planning modules in Autoware
Validated closed-loop autonomy in CARLA and VI-grade with Stellantis engineers
Built synthetic data pipelines using Parallel Domain with HD maps and multimodal sensors
Designed and validated multi-camera and multi-LiDAR calibration rigs

work.name: Buyutech (Techlabs at MCity)
work.summary: Built and deployed real-time stereo perception systems for on-vehicle ADAS testing.
highlights: Deployed stereo vision using Stereolabs ZEDX and Jetson Orin
Performed hardware bring-up, synchronization, and on-vehicle validation
Achieved 22 ms inference latency with 1.57% depth error
